answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks using hardware-based remote attestation. Agents must register through an attestation inlet that verifies cryptographic quotes signed by physical secure enclaves. This structure forces an attacker to acquire distinct silicon processors per identity, driving equipment costs to a prohibitive zenith and denying bot farms a cheap haven. However, the mechanism relies on trusted hardware vendors and remains susceptible to silicon side-channel leaks.
